formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the owner's ARB allowance for `spender` to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit -> _approve(owner, spender, value)).
A value of type(uint256).max gives an allowance that transferFrom never decreases. Any other value goes down as the spender uses it.
Uses up the owner's current nonce, which cancels any other signed permit that has the same nonce.
The signature only works until `deadline`. Anyone may submit it, and no tokens move when it is submitted.
formats.shown: The screen shows 'Authorize spending of tokens' with these fields: the spender address (raw), the max spending amount in ARB ('Unlimited' at or above 2^255), the valid-until date and the owner.
